songs.comments: I like the bridge a lot

songs.comments: The "ee er" in the background sounds pretty funny. I don't love the autotune but the vocals are pretty good. Chorus is a bit repetitive. So is the background.

Believer

Put Out The Fire - Remastered 2011

songs.comments: Might just be a preference but I really don't like these vocals. I don't like how some parts just suddenly cut off and it doesn't sound very well supported. I don't like how the song builds as if it's going to climax then just drops.

songs.comments: Slightly repetitive chorus

songs.comments: Intro is very good. Some lyrics like "golden eagle" and "queen of hearts" feel a bit random because they don't seem to be connected to one theme. The chorus feels a bit out of place. Background, lyrics and cohesion could be scored lower.
songs.name: Past Lives
Home

songs.name: Careless Talk
songs.comments: His entrance feels a little off timed? His technique on some of these turns is very good though. Some parts feel a little off, the bridge is one. It kind of lacks a conclusion too so I deducted from flow.

songs.name: The Lazy Song

songs.album: We Sing. We Dance. We Steal Things.

Come A Little Bit Closer

songs.name: Mayonaka no Door / Stay With Me
Brandy (You're a Fine Girl)
songs.comments: I like that the lyrics have a story.

Raspberry Beret

songs.comments: Kind of repetitive. Vocals kind of stick out a bit. I don't really like the way the last line of the bridge was delivered.

Hooked On A Feeling

songs.comments: Emotion in lyrics and background feels incongruent. Vocals are emotional and the background feels very "chill" and "vibey." The water sound is also a bit intrusive
songs.name: 애정결핍

songs.comments: The vocals almost have too much detail and are slightly too loud. Not a huge fan of the English lyrics but overall the lyrics are good. Not a big fan of the rap section. I like how the last verse calls back to the first.
songs.name: Song Request 신청곡 (feat. SUGA of BTS)
songs.album: Song Request 신청곡 (feat. SUGA of BTS)

songs.name: Night Light
songs.comments: Blends well. Lyrics fit with a consistent theme. I guess some of the wording in the lyrics is a bit pedestrian, could lower the score. The song has clear lows and highs giving it motion.

songs.name: El Mismo Sol
songs.comments: Quite repetitive.
The variations and additional vocals in the last chorus were pretty nice.
songs.name: Wildest Dreams

songs.comments: I like how the sections have repeated formats but the phrases are changed. All the parts fit pretty nicely with the theme set by the lyrics. The background gives that kind of industrial vibe.
songs.name: Allentown

songs.comments: I like the lines starting with "a noise in the city" and "down on the corner." It is a little odd how it builds up to the chorus which then is rather low energy. Vocals are a mixed bag. Some lyrics are a little confusing in isolation, mostly in verse 3.
songs.name: Rain Is Falling

songs.comments: Vocals are a little too aggressive in the pre-chorus I feel, especially after the intro was very calm. It does feel a little odd how it peaks in the pre-chorus then goes down for the actual chorus? Background feels very basic.
songs.name: Lights Down Low

songs.comments: Main criticisms, bridge is a bit random and the song is pretty repetitive. The lyrics are also feels a little random or generic. The song peaks really well.
songs.name: Summer and Lightning
Michelle - Remastered 2009
songs.comments: "These are words that go together well" isn't a great line in my opinion. Lyrics get a little repetitive too. Flow score could go down but at least some of the words vary and the outro was pretty nice.

songs.album: 我的愛 我的夢 我的家
songs.comments: Structure isn't great. There are only two distinct sections, one is repeated three times. The delivery is changed slightly. The background interacts very well with the vocals. Score is a bit too high on this one.
songs.name: 最浪漫的事
King And Lionheart
songs.comments: I wish there were more unique verses man.
The melody is very odd at the beginning and at several points throughout, I reflected that in the deduction to cohesion. I like the bass.
songs.name: Cherries Jubiles
Here With Me
songs.comments: Really unique melody. Vocals are a little unconventional, you would expect them to be a little more delicate considering the rest of the song. It kind of fits with the background though.

Lyrics are beautiful and haunting. I do almost feel like the last chorus went the wrong way maybe. I think it should've quietly died down instead of trying to climax. Strangely Spotify says the line is "dry as the walls" instead of "white as the walls."
songs.name: Sugar in a Bowl
songs.album: My Head Is An Animal (10th Anniversary Edition)

songs.name: Runaway Baby
songs.comments: Really nice riff. Credit where it's due, the line "there's only one carrot and they all gotta share it" is good. Having "runaway" in the name even though the song says "run away" is interesting. A bit repetitive and it just ends on another chorus.

songs.artists: Danger Mouse, Black Thought, MF DOOM
songs.name: Belize (feat. MF DOOM)
怒放的生命
songs.comments: I think the YouTube version is better. Chorus gets repeated A LOT. Banger chorus but still repetitive. Because it's live there are a lot more small errors in the vocals. I love it in rock songs when they tell the band to go again though.

I've heard the criticism that their voice is a bit "whiny" here but I think it fits. The whole song is on the same page about the character being a bit pathetic. I don't hate the flow but there are four repeated choruses.
songs.name: Stay With Me

songs.comments: That "craving" stuck out a lot lol. His voice sounds a bit timid, which suits a lot of the song but not some of these aggressive entrances. Some strange choices for the melody at the bridge? I like that I can feel what he was going for.
songs.name: Line Without a Hook
Poker Face
songs.comments: Lyrics and delivery in the intro are incredible. Aside from that it gets a bit repetitive. The synth around the middle is very disorienting with headphones on.
I feel like this should be higher but it’s kind of basic. Maybe I’m wrong.
songs.name: She's Always a Woman

songs.comments: Lyrics are definitely a little weird in isolation but they fit well with the vibe of the song. Lyrics are a little repetitive and the song doesn't really go anywhere
songs.name: Walk This Way

songs.comments: The rap actually fits pretty well. The Maneskin version actually takes its rap verse from this one apparently.
songs.name: Beggin'

songs.comments: Had to deduct a bit for the lyrics. 56709 is repeated a lot and it's just not a great lyric. Still kind of works though
songs.name: テレフォン・ナンバー
Love Grows (Where My Rosemary Goes)
songs.album: Love Grows (Where My Rosemary Goes) & Other Gems

songs.name: Love Flew Away
songs.comments: The parts blend well. You can feel that the song has a direction as it rises and falls.

songs.name: Long Cool Woman (In a Black Dress) - 1999 Remaster

songs.comments: Structure isn't great, just an intro and two choruses.
songs.name: 一翦梅
Nobody Gets Me
songs.comments: The sad longing vocals don't really fit with some of the incredibly crass lyrics. The pitch correction, especially during the turns, is a bit over the top in my opinion, though I assume it's stylistic.
That last crazy turn at the end sounded a bit out of control to me. I feel like the instrumental is lacking a bit of percussion. Lyrics sound good but they are a bit repetitive.
songs.name: Heavenly Road (Tian Lu)
songs.album: Golden Melodies: Songs of the New Era Vol. 1 (Jin Se De Xuan Lv: Dang Dai Yuan Chuang Shu Qing Ge Qu Yi)

songs.name: Young Dumb & Broke
songs.comments: Not sure if I like the vocals or not. The way he sings sounds lazy, which matches the laid back theme of the song, but also just sounds kind of grating. Bridge isn't great. Background is pretty basic. A bit repetitive.
The mix of hoarseness and desperation in the vocals is very unique. The lyrics are extremely repetitive.
songs.name: Twist And Shout - Remastered 2009
She's Gone
songs.comments: Four distinct verses and each one has lyrics that express powerful feelings of grief and sorrow. A lot of chorus admittedly. There are ups and downs in the song but overall it climbs to the climax in the outro. The percussion in the background is great.

songs.name: Dirty Paws
songs.comments: I get that the lyrics are supposedly related to WW2 but some of the word choices aren't great. There's so much focus on the verses that the climax doesn't have lyrics which makes it feel less meaningful?

songs.name: Smells Like Teen Spirit
songs.comments: This was a pretty confusing one to grade. The instrumental and vocals have a lot of raw emotion. The pre chorus and chorus still make up too much of the song.

songs.album: Man On The Moon: The End Of Day
songs.name: Pursuit Of Happiness (Nightmare)
songs.comments: The lyrics just start repeating in the second half. Granted, the execution is different, but not having any new unique lyrics feels like a mistake. I debated on raising the background score, still not sure.
A surprisingly good song? Although the chorus repeats a lot, the execution varies and more parts are added throughout the song.
songs.name: All About That Bass

songs.comments: I don't like how it just repeats the earlier section and lines at the end. Everything before the chorus (the section where "blackbird fly" repeats) is really good.
songs.name: Blackbird - Remastered 2009

songs.artists: Andrew Lloyd Webber, Patrick Wilson, Emmy Rossum
songs.name: All I Ask Of You - From 'The Phantom Of The Opera' Motion Picture
songs.album: The Phantom Of The Opera (Original Motion Picture Soundtrack)

songs.name: 7 Years
songs.comments: Not personally a huge fan of this song but it does a lot of things right. The flow is great because of the theme of age and it also calls back to the beginning at the end. This also gives it a lot of unique lyrics. I'm probably underrating it because of my bias.

songs.name: 紅豆
songs.comments: Seems like a lot of canto pop songs have the formula of slowly adding instruments to make the next chorus peak higher. Not the most revolutionary but definitely not bad.

songs.name: Bad - 2012 Remaster
songs.comments: Some parts of the background are a little repetitive but overall it's good.
Not a big fan of the verse by Goldlink
songs.name: BLACK BALLOONS | 13LACK 13ALLOONZ [FEAT. TWELVE'LEN & GOLDLINK | TWELVE'LEN + GOLDL1NK]

songs.comments: Vocals feel very technical. Really nice lyrics, as expected since it's a jazz standard. The song has a rising and falling motion. Nothing special about cohesion I don't think, the background mostly is just getting out of the way of the vocals.
songs.name: Misty
Love On The Brain
songs.comments: Ending could've been better, it was a bit abrupt.

songs.name: King
songs.comments: The quality of her voice is really good for this song. I admittedly don't like how much the chorus repeats. Some of the lyrics are good, others are a little corny.  It feels like there was the idea to have the song build a lot but it never got there.

songs.name: Cupid - Twin Version
songs.comments: Pretty solid song but maybe a bit basic? Words like "stupid" and "dumb" feel a bit pedestrian. Vocals would be a bit better without the slight accent. I like the bridge a lot. I do not like how the song ends suddenly after a repeated chorus.
Lyrics are pretty odd. Background score could arguably be raised, it was a pretty fire guitar solo.
songs.name: Peace Frog
Sunday Morning
songs.comments: Bridge is a little odd but it recovers well into the next section

Very short and simple in terms of flow and lyrics. I didn't want to lower lyric score since the song is so short anyway, but you could argue they repeat and are overly simplistic. I thought it was fine.
songs.name: Forever - Single Version
The Adults Are Talking
songs.comments: The bridge is incredible. Lyrics are mixed. Lines like "you want me to do it the same way as you," "I don't want anything," and "I don't want anyone" don't seem to fit with "I know you think of me when you think of her."

songs.name: arms
songs.comments: Cohesion score might be too high on this one
Lyrics are a little basic and cheesy. A few lines sound like they needed a few more syllables, like "for that night" and "needed you most." Instrumental is also pretty basic.
songs.name: Say You Won't Let Go
Light My Fire
songs.comments: Lyrics are repetitive and don't contribute much. I personally don't mind the instrumental but it is pretty long.
Don't love the intro. I like the background though, the score could definitely be raised.
songs.name: days gone by

songs.comments: I do like how much "personality" this song has. Parts get added throughout the song which helps the flow. I could see an argument that the cohesion score should be raised.
songs.name: Shake It Off
The Long And Winding Road - Remastered 2015

songs.artists: Danny Chan, Rico Fung and David at Studio A, Tom Brown
songs.comments: An intro and two choruses isn't great, but even just the short outro improves the flow a bit.
songs.name: 偏偏喜歡你
Serendipity
songs.comments: Lyrics are overall pretty solid on this one but I will mention that I don’t like when lyrics include a specific number of unknown significance like “twenty-three”

I like the song but it is a little confusing between some of the edgy and nonsensical lyrics and extremely upbeat instrumental. Structure is also a little weird with the repeated "the mask that you wore" section into an instrumental.
songs.name: Easy Ride

songs.comments: The background vocals add a lot
songs.name: Uptown Girl

songs.comments: I don't really like the percussion in the background (clapping I think?). It feels a bit out of place to me and makes the song feel too casual
songs.name: I Wish You Love

songs.comments: Some of the lyrics definitely aren't great, like "I haven't written a sad song" and "finally pick a movie, then we'll fall asleep." The shift from present to future is also very sudden. I like the ending though.
songs.name: Best Friend
Fragile
songs.comments: Lyrics are a mixed bag. I don't really like "case of fragile glass," I think it's too direct. "A year and forty days since you picked me up and swept me away" is very specific and the rhyming feels tacky.

songs.name: Happy - From "Despicable Me 2"
songs.comments: The song gets very repetitive at the end. I honestly feel like it would've been better if it ended at the 2:43 mark instead of going for another repetition.

Vocals are a little odd, might be an acquired taste. Background is uninspiring for most of the song except for the bridge. You could argue all the parts fit together with the theme? Overall, a very weird song to grade, very unconventional.
songs.album: Parade - Music from the Motion Picture Under the Cherry Moon
songs.name: Kiss
Hello
songs.comments: The background builds throughout the song but it does generally feel very simplistic and underwhelming to me. A dedicated outro would've made this song much better.

I feel that the low sections aren't sad enough and the high sections don't sound angry enough to match the story in the lyrics. Lyrics are a little edgy but understandably so given the setting. Sounds like the audio bugs a bit around the 2 minute mark.
songs.name: Paint It, Black
It's Still Rock and Roll to Me
Dernière danse
songs.comments: I don't like the kind of techno style that comes in at the second half. Her voice also sounds like it's being garbled by pitch correction.
Drums are pretty cool. I didn't like some of the vocals that sounded more "spoken" and a few of the sound effects. Generally the song feels very unique and interesting though.
Lyrics feel a bit nonsensical and repetitive
songs.name: Love Me Two Times
Faded
songs.comments: Definitely not my preferred music genre but I gotta admit it's pretty hype

songs.artists: Daft Punk, Pharrell Williams, Nile Rodgers
songs.name: Get Lucky (feat. Pharrell Williams and Nile Rodgers)

songs.comments: For its purpose the lyrics were obviously effectively but outside of that context it kind of feels like I'm listening to a scuffle that I have no part in. Background is basic and repetitive.
songs.name: Not Like Us

songs.comments: I find his voice a bit grating but you could argue it also has a lot of emotion.
songs.name: Truce

songs.comments: The bridge is a bit odd but it leads well into the next section.
songs.name: L.A. Woman
This Love
songs.comments: A lot of chorus but it changes at the end and I love the bridge.

Each progressive chorus actually does noticeably peak higher than the last. The added background vocals in the last chorus are actually very nice. I do wish there were more distinct lyrics and verses but generally the lyrics are solid.
songs.name: Roar

songs.comments: Funny story with a great twist. Background is repetitive. The story improves the flow.
songs.name: Wet Dreamz

songs.comments: Not a fan of the second verse. Pronunciation isn't bad but vocals would be improved if it was better.
songs.name: seasons
California Gurls
songs.comments: Probably a bit harsh to deduct from vocals but they sound a bit awkward to me, the words feel stiff and forced. It's also a bit repetitive.
I don't really like the pre-chorus, it feels a bit out of place with the rest of the song. I lowered flow a bit because of that combined with the chorus being a bit repetitive.
songs.name: My House
On Top Of The World
songs.comments: I absolutely love the transition into the bridge on this song.

I really don't like the bridge. I think it completely ruins the vibe of the song for me as something very bittersweet. Aside from that I really like how the song sounds a bit confused on whether it's a bit more upbeat or melancholy. Kind of like denial?
songs.name: Dreamer's Ball - Remastered 2011
Good Life
songs.comments: Only criticism of the lyrics is that I think the last section at the end could've been its own unique verse instead of repeating the second verse.

songs.name: Feel It Still
songs.comments: Pretty repetitive chorus. Song also does give a feeling like it went nowhere. It ended pretty much where it started but because that was a repeated section it doesn't have the same impact as a callback.

songs.name: Dancing With A Stranger (with Normani)
songs.comments: I feel like I waited for the song to go somewhere but it never did. Vocals in the first verse were pretty impressive. Background is exceedingly bland.

songs.album: Songs In The Key Of Life
songs.comments: The song drags on a bit with the audio from what I assume is the birth of his child playing, which is also too loud.
songs.name: Isn't She Lovely

songs.album: At The Close Of A Century
songs.name: I Just Called To Say I Love You

songs.comments: Crazy falsetto. I absolutely love the instrumental on this one but the score might be a bit high.
songs.name: Cool Cat - Remastered 2011

songs.comments: Pretty repetitive. The line "why you gotta be so rude" also just sounds a bit crude, which I suppose fits the character here, but still just isn't nice to listen to.
songs.name: Rude

songs.comments: He cuts the phrases pretty short. I guess if they were too long it wouldn't fit with the high energy background? The lyrics definitely have a progression, kind of towards acceptance. Maybe a little too high energy for the lyrics.
songs.name: Baby Blue - Remastered 2010
Mirrors - Radio Edit
songs.comments: Could have benefitted from an outro in my opinion. The song is also just dominated by sections that get repeated.

songs.name: Better When You're High
songs.comments: The chorus is always exactly the same and the lyrics in the rap verses feel overly crude. It feels like there was some unexplored potential with the bittersweet sound in the chorus.
"The only thing that matters now is everything You think of me" is a terrifying line. It's pretty repetitive.
songs.name: You Say
Say Something
songs.artists: A Great Big World, Christina Aguilera
songs.comments: A very good example of building throughout the song and changing the delivery on the same lyric

songs.name: Wouldn't It Be Nice
songs.comments: Background vocals do a lot for this song

songs.album: Yesterday, Today, Tomorrow - The Greatest Hits Of Kenny Loggins
songs.name: Footloose

songs.comments: I do like how the instruments come in during the second half, and how the song concludes the way it started.
songs.name: 因為愛情

songs.comments: Did they just invent the phrase "I'm not into bacon?" Lyrics are kind of hilarious but the character is supposed to be upset. Song is very upbeat? Bridge is great.
songs.name: I Found A Girl

songs.comments: The vocals sound a little garbled in the distinct verses. It's quite repetitive. Not a fan of the Snow White line, it feels petty and the message of that story doesn't seem very similar to the one in this song.
songs.name: Sit Still, Look Pretty
24K Magic
songs.comments: Difficult song to grade. I kind of just don't like repeated sections. Maybe it's because of the energy level of the song but I feel like even one direct repetition has me wonder a bit why I'm listening to the same thing again.
I like the lyrics in the first two verses a lot. The vocals very dynamic which makes the lyrics feel less repetitive, especially in the outro.
songs.album: A Day At The Races (Deluxe Remastered Version)
songs.name: Somebody To Love - Remastered 2011
Who's Lovin' You
songs.comments: The vocals are excellent but they do stick out a little bit. I actually love the background vocals in the outro.

songs.name: Here Comes The Sun - Remastered 2009
songs.comments: Lyrics are a little simplistic. Maybe a bit too much repetition of certain words, even in the unique verses, but generally lyrics are solid. The song doesn't really go anywhere at the end unfortunately.

I don't like how the song was made to insult people, even if they are rich and spoiled. I always heard the chorus as someone getting a rush of happiness from some substance in their otherwise miserable life. I guess that's kind of correct?
songs.name: Captain Jack

songs.album: The Very Best of Frankie Valli & The 4 Seasons
songs.name: Can't Take My Eyes off You
songs.comments: Lyrics are a bit repetitive but good
Flow score reduced because I feel like the bridge doesn't fit perfectly and because the song keeps the same format until the last verse
songs.name: Don't Ask Me Why

songs.comments: I promise the lyrics aren't transphobic. Still, they're a bit awkward and repetitive.
songs.name: Dude (Looks Like A Lady)

songs.comments: Some lyrics like "Emerald Bar" are a bit random. It's a story about a character but the song is too short to flesh it out. I do like the simplicity of the chorus lyrics and lines like "you've got not real ambition" though.
songs.name: Spread Your Wings - Remastered 2011
songs.album: News Of The World (Deluxe Remastered Version)

songs.name: Tell Her About It
songs.comments: I like the theme of the lyrics being advice. There are a lot of unique lines.

songs.name: Bohemian Rhapsody
songs.comments: This song is all over the place. The third verse and bridge are completely different and the lyrics are more nonsensical. I do like how it returns to the same theme as the first half at the end though. Scoring on this one is very questionable.

songs.name: a thousand years
songs.comments: The dreaded 2 verse 3 chorus flow. And no real bridge. At least they introduce some more instruments later I guess.

songs.name: drive ME crazy!
songs.comments: I like the first section a lot more than the rest

songs.name: Illusions in G Major
songs.comments: Very nonsensical lyrics. Ends pretty suddenly.
The vocals carry a lot of emotion. Lyrics are beautiful. Small criticism, the transition from "wish you were here" to "we're just two lost souls" is a bit awkward.
songs.name: Wish You Were Here
Shangri-La
songs.comments: The lyrics in general are very good, but that one line "Faded like The Beatles on 'Hey Jude'" is disastrous. It doesn't help that the melody is disrupted and paused on that line, which further emphasizes it. I made some pretty harsh deductions for those.

Very repetitive. Chorus repeats four times and the chorus itself is one line repeated four times. Even the bridge just repeats part of the first verse. The few distinct lyrics are pretty basic. Lyrics pretty much only accessorize the beat.
songs.name: We Found Love

songs.comments: I like the idea but some of the lyrics feel a little too on the nose maybe? The bridge also messes with the consistent rhythm a bit in my opinion, maybe some kind of a dance break?
songs.name: Born This Way

songs.comments: Very strange kind of "squiggly?" sound effect in the background around 1:12. Some phrases are delivered a bit strangely, some weird ideas with the rhyming. Bridge repeats lyrics from the intro.
songs.name: 400 Lux
The Way Life's Meant to Be
songs.comments: Some phrases are a little choppy, I guess I don't think drawing them out would sound better. I like the structure, three unique verses and an outro. I could see flow score being raised.

songs.name: -Error
songs.comments: You can definitely hear the strain for the high notes but it's still insanely impressive
I don't like the heavily autotuned section but aside from that he's clearly a good singer.
songs.name: Some Nights

songs.comments: Some of the phrases cut off a bit too sharply in the vocals. It makes the vocals feel a little out of sync with the background during the unique verses. A lot of the lyrics are kind of basic or repetitive.
songs.name: Sweet Is the Night

songs.comments: The vocals are nice but almost a little too breathy even if that's the intended style.
songs.name: What Was I Made For? [From The Motion Picture "Barbie"]
songs.album: What Was I Made For? [From The Motion Picture "Barbie"]

songs.name: Last Train to London
songs.comments: Not too much going in the lyrics or flow but the instrumental is pretty infectious.

songs.name: Piano Man
songs.comments: All the parts work together to create the kind of dingy atmosphere. I do like how the song builds but I can't raise the flow because it repeats the same pattern so many times
I keep hearing "que paso" at the start of the chorus
songs.name: You Were Beautiful
Comin' Home Baby
songs.comments: Really cool instrumental. The song gets a little repetitive and doesn't have a clear conclusion. The lyrics do vary slightly so I only deducted from flow, arguably lyrics should be deducted too.

I like how the instruments get added one by one. Bass drop was pretty underwhelming. Bridge moves into the last chorus well. I like the added backing vocals in the last chorus. Chorus does feel a little out of place and is just lacking bass.
songs.name: I Knew You Were Trouble.

songs.comments: Every chorus is virtually identical.
songs.name: Set Fire to the Rain

songs.comments: I really like the lines "Come back and haunt me" and "do not speak as loud as my heart." The song builds upwards throughout.
songs.name: The Scientist
songs.album: A Rush of Blood to the Head

songs.name: The Way You Make Me Feel - 2012 Remaster
songs.comments: The song is very long and meanders a bit. The sections that are clearly designed for dance breaks in a live performance don't help the flow either.

I took a bit off of flow because I didn't like how it transitioned from chorus into an incredibly short bridge back into a chorus that was almost identical. A lot of scores here are on the upper edge though.
songs.name: Cake By The Ocean
Beast Of Burden - Remastered 1994
songs.comments: A lot of the lyrics feel vague or erratic.

songs.name: When She Loved Me - From "Toy Story 2" / Soundtrack Version
songs.comments: Beautiful story in the lyrics that has a clear flow of time.
Lyrics are very generic, nothing really interesting there. Instrumental is great though.
songs.name: Afraid of Love
Asleep Among Endives
songs.comments: Song length lowered flow score

songs.name: Love Never Felt So Good (Original Version)
songs.comments: Although he does change the way he sings the sections when he repeats, the song still has a very odd structure where it essentially repeats three times with no bridge
I generally like this song. I like the line "Oh, what a shame that you came here with someone." Only complaint is that the chorus repeats too often without much variation.
songs.name: Die Young

songs.album: Jeff Lynne's ELO - Alone in the Universe
songs.name: Ain't It a Drag
Shouldn't Be
songs.comments: I feel like it almost sounds a little too upbeat? I do like the line "would you feel a thing if you saw me right now." I don't like how that version of the chorus gets repeated though, it makes it feel less impactful. The bridge also doesn't quite fit.

songs.artists: Mac Miller, Empire Of The Sun
songs.name: The Spins

songs.comments: Solid mix of lyrics that I like and don't like so I'd say it evens out. Vocals at the end are really good but they aren't that good throughout the whole song
songs.name: Red Wine Supernova
songs.album: The Rise and Fall of a Midwest Princess

songs.name: Fly Me To The Moon - 2008 Remastered
Come and Get Your Love - Single Version

songs.comments: The distortion on his voice during "Dynamite with a laser beam" is odd. The song also feels a bit choppy.
songs.name: Killer Queen - Remastered 2011

songs.comments: This is a hard one. I think vocals, background and cohesion all could debatably be increased
songs.name: Space Song
Start Me Up - Remastered 2009
songs.comments: A good example of how even a small change to a line in the chorus can improve the lyrics. Even so I could see the lyrics and flow being lower

songs.name: Latitude 88 North
songs.comments: I like everything except the chorus which kind of sticks out

songs.name: Three Man Weave
songs.comments: Beginning almost reminds me of Fazers. I like the background a lot. I feel like just repeating the first verse multiple times at the end was pretty lazy. Not a big fan of how the line "now me, Groggs and P doin' the three man weave, though" sounds.

songs.name: Moves Like Jagger - Studio Recording From "The Voice" Performance
songs.comments: The background vocals by Christina Aguilera in the last chorus help a lot.

songs.name: Starboy
songs.comments: Ending so many lines with "ah" is pretty interesting at the beginning but gets a little old as it gets repeated. I like the line "I switch up my cup, I kill any pain." It changes the tone a bit after so many lines of boasting. A bit repetitive.

songs.album: Ultimate Big Band Collection: Glenn Miller
songs.name: Chattanooga Choo Choo
We Are Young (feat. Janelle Monáe)
songs.comments: Nice outro. Kind of saves the flow. Could argue that vocal score should be higher.

songs.name: Lovefool
songs.comments: A bit of an odd feeling from how upbeat the background is? Lyrics are more sad and the vocals sound like they're far away, maybe to create a bittersweet feeling? It's on the edge in terms of repetitiveness for me. Distinct verses are good.

songs.album: News Of The World (Deluxe Remastered Version)
songs.name: We Are The Champions - Remastered 2011
songs.comments: I think I associate this song too much with sporting events which makes it feel very shallow. With that being said, I'm not sure how much depth there could be to the line "we are the champions." Seems pretty blatant what the song wants to say.
Some very odd sections to this song
songs.name: Jungle
Righteous Minds
songs.comments: I don't dislike the rapping but it sounds like rushes a bit at some parts. Chorus repeats a lot. Backing track isn't bad but it's also repetitive as usual.
I like how drums and strings are added as the song goes on. Chorus repeats a few times at the end but it's noticeable changing and building.
